# Open-source agentic LLM harnesses — the most beloved (as of 2026-08-28)

**Question.** Which open-source agentic LLM harnesses does the community actually love?

**Short answer.** By every adoption and sentiment signal, the 2026 open-source harness landscape is led by **opencode** (202k stars — the default open coding agent), **DeepSeek Harness** (201k stars in ~2 weeks — the newest phenomenon), **OpenClaw** (388k) and **Hermes** (237k) for always-on personal agents, first-party open CLIs **Codex** (119k) and **Gemini CLI** (107k), and **pi** (98.6k — the beloved minimal harness). In coding specifically, **OpenHands** (85k), **Cline** (67k), **goose** (53.6k), and **aider** (48.5k, now dormant) are the long-standing favorites. "Beloved" here means stars plus HN traction plus roundup rankings, not just raw size.

## What a harness is

A model answers; an agent acts. The harness is the runtime that turns one into the other: the tool loop, the permission model, the context management, the recovery behavior. Simon Willison: "an LLM agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal." Karpathy named the architecture in 2023: the model is "the kernel process of a new Operating System," and the harness is the rest of that OS. The SWE-agent paper proved the stakes with the *agent-computer interface*: how tools and feedback are presented changes what a model can do, independent of the model. Source: best-of-agent-harnesses-readme.md.

## The beloved, by tier

### Tier 0 — the personal-agent phenomena (harness pattern beyond coding)

| Project | Stars | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| OpenClaw | 388k | Local-first personal AI assistant on any OS ("the lobster way"); ex-Clawdbot/Moltbot. The most-discussed harness of 2026 — mostly because Anthropic and Google restricted their subscription products over it (see hn-sentiment-stories.md). |
| Hermes (Nous Research) | 237k | "The agent that grows with you" — always-on personal agent. |
| Khoj | 37k | Self-hosted second brain, the older generation of this category. |

### Tier 1 — terminal coding agents (the core of the question)

| Project | Stars | License | Why loved |
|---|---|---|---|
| opencode (Anomaly, ex-SST) | 202k | MIT | "The default open-source pick for most builders in 2026" (explainx #1). 75+ providers, local models, client/server design so the agent can run headless or remote. HN launch: 1274 points. |
